explanation_excerpt: AG-UI is the courier carrying an agent run; A2UI is the blueprint for a user interface; Prometheus is the security desk between the official renderer and the normalized graph.

gaps.description: The exact public TypeScript names and compatibility-subpath export map remain task 2 implementation details; their governing boundaries are frozen here.
No renderer has been changed in this dependency task, so real browser, keyboard, accessibility, and policy-outcome evidence must be produced by later tasks.

transfer_problems: Does a working AG-UI STATE_DELTA chat projection prove official A2UI rendering?
May an official A2UI component mutate the entity graph directly after schema validation?
May a local JSONL parser replace web_core if its tests pass?
How must a v1.0 candidate message be handled by the stable v0.9.1 bridge?
What is the policy for unknown components and unapproved destructive actions?
May workspace tests waive a broken packed v0_9 dependency path?
misconception_review: No AG-UI/A2UI category error, distribution/protocol version conflation, schema/authorization conflation, workspace/tarball conflation, or screenshot/certification conflation remains in the explanation.
grading_method: Source-grounded self-assessment against official A2UI and AG-UI documentation plus isolated current package declarations; no claim of human learner mastery is made.
